Here are the available commands and their input schema for 'advisor' tool.
If you do not find a suitable "command", run again with the "learn=true" to get a list of available commands and their parameters.
Next, identify the command you want to execute and run again with the "command" and "parameters" arguments, respecting "required" parameters if present.

[{"command":"advisor_recommendation_summary","description":"Summarize the key themes from Azure Advisor recommendation instances in a subscription or Azure service group using server-side counts, totals, rankings, and distributions. For --category Cost --sub-category IdleResources, start here to find unused Azure resources you are paying for and summarize their key themes, potential savings, accumulated waste, and realized savings. Historical savings cover resources deleted during --from/--to as of --as-of. Totals cover all matches; unavailable savings remain null. These are Advisor retail estimates, not billing history. For Cost/IdleResources, explicit --status overrides lifecycle defaults; historical reports default to Completed. Also supports --subscriptions, metadata service-family and minimum annual potential-savings filters, and Service Groups in the selected tenant. This is the aggregate-only tool for questions such as how many, count, breakdown, distribution, most common, which has the most, or how many overdue service-retirement Advisor recommendations are still active. Use it for an executive summary or main themes, counts by category or business impact, the most common recommendation types, ranking resource types by critical or High-impact recommendations, lifecycle counts for New, Completed, Dismissed, and Postponed recommendations, and metadata subcategory breakdowns such as ZoneResiliency. This is the starting tool for top recommendations, top actions to take, most critical, most important, prioritized, highest-priority, or what-should-I-fix-first requests: set --prioritized true to rank active recommendation types by priority and explain each rank, instead of starting with recommendation list. Explain a ranking in plain business language from the group\u0027s prioritizationSignals, without exposing field names, raw values, or scores. After a prioritized summary, list the records or affected resources of a selected type with recommendation list --recommendation-type-ids containing only its key and --prioritized true, adding --category Cost for a Cost type. Count active service-retirement Advisor recommendations with retirement dates on, before, or after a specified date, including overdue recommendations that are still active, or group them by retirement date. Use this tool to answer how many overdue service-retirement Advisor recommendations are still active. Retirement filters are one-sided: le:\u003Cend-date\u003E includes every active recommendation retiring on or before the end date, including overdue retirements, and is not a bounded next-N window. Use explicit exact, on-or-before, or on-or-after retirement-date questions; recommendation list is capped and must not be counted client-side. Group by recommendation-type, category, impact, resource-type, status, sub-category, or retirement-date; category is the default. All groups return canonical key, label, and count values. Recommendation-type keys are recommendation type ID GUIDs with English metadata labels. All groupings except status include only active New recommendations; status includes every backend lifecycle state. Use either --subscriptions or --service-group, not both. A configured default subscription is used when neither is supplied. --resource-group applies only with subscription scope. Filters include category, impact, recommendation type ID, impacted resource type, resource name or ARM ID, problem-text search, subcategory, and explicit retirement-date comparisons. Use --search with this summary tool for topical aggregate questions such as counts or impact breakdowns for recommendations mentioning encryption or right-size; do not call recommendation list and count its capped results. Use recommendation list instead when the user wants individual recommendation records. TotalRecommendations always covers the complete filtered population, even when --top limits displayed buckets; with --prioritized true it is the sum of affected resources per type, so a resource is counted once for each recommendation type that affects it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"service-group":{"type":"string","description":"The ID of the Azure service group whose recommendations should be summarized, provided as the name segment in its ARM resource ID, for example \u0027/providers/Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups/{serviceGroupName}\u0027. Specify either --service-group or --subscriptions. If both are omitted, the configured default subscription is used. A unique display name or full ARM resource ID is also accepted in the selected tenant; ambiguous display names produce an error listing matching full ARM IDs for explicit selection."},"group-by":{"type":"string","description":"Optional field to group the summary by. One of: \u0027recommendation-type\u0027, \u0027category\u0027, \u0027impact\u0027, \u0027resource-type\u0027, \u0027status\u0027, \u0027sub-category\u0027, or \u0027retirement-date\u0027. Defaults to \u0027category\u0027 when omitted, which surfaces the high-level themes (Cost, Security, Reliability, etc.) so prompts like \u0027summarize the key themes from my Advisor recommendations\u0027 work without naming a field. Use \u0027recommendation-type\u0027 without --prioritized for frequency questions such as the most common recommendation types; its counts are recommendation records. With --prioritized true, omit this option; prioritized summaries are always grouped by recommendation type."},"prioritized":{"type":["boolean","null"],"description":"Rank matching recommendation types by priority instead of counting records. Defaults to false; recommendations default to New. Only Cost with subcategory IdleResources supports summary status overrides and historical inputs, which default to Completed unless status is explicit. Set to true for top recommendations, top actions to take, most critical, most important, highest-priority, or what-should-I-fix-first requests, overall or within filters such as category Cost; pass a requested count as --top (default 10). Do not set it for frequency questions such as how many or most common. Groups by recommendation-type. Ranking: metadata priority descending, then savings descending, summed criticality descending, retirement date ascending, affected-resource count ascending for Cost and descending otherwise, case-insensitive label ascending, and recommendation type ID ascending. Missing priority, savings, criticality, and retirement values sort last. Savings means annual potential savings, or realized savings for Completed Cost/IdleResources recommendations. Summary ranking uses full precision; returned money is rounded to two decimals. Each group\u0027s count is its distinct affected resources, and totalRecommendations is the sum of those counts across all ranked types, not a record count; each group\u0027s prioritizationSignals object can hold category, impact, subCategory, retirementDate, retirementWindow, annualSavings with USD currency, yearlyPotentialSavings, cost, realizedSavings, resourceTypeCriticality, criticalService, effort, actionability, and costImplication; absent fields are unknown, never zero. To explain a ranking, answer from prioritizationSignals in two or three plain business sentences, leading with impact, then retirementWindow or subCategory, then the other signals; translate values (retirementPastDue: retirement date has passed; qcs: critical service) and never mention field names, raw values, or scores, or guess absent attributes. For details or affected resources of a listed type, call recommendation list with --recommendation-type-ids containing only its key and --prioritized true, keeping the scope and filters, plus --category Cost for a Cost type."},"category":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by category. Allowed values are Cost, HighAvailability, Security, Performance, and OperationalExcellence. Matched case-insensitively against recommendation-type metadata. Cost with subcategory IdleResources also returns complete savings and pricing-availability aggregates in summary.cost, independent of --top and --prioritized."},"impact":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by business impact. Allowed values are High, Medium, and Low. Matched case-insensitively against recommendation-type metadata."},"status":{"type":"string","description":"For Cost with subcategory IdleResources only, filter summaries by lifecycle state: New, Postponed, Dismissed, or Completed. An explicit status takes precedence. When omitted, historical inputs default to Completed; otherwise status grouping includes all states and other groupings default to New. Outside Cost/IdleResources, status grouping retains all states and other summaries retain New."},"recommendation-type-ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Filter recommendations by one or more recommendation type ID GUIDs using OR semantics. Matching is case-insensitive; pass a one-element array for one type."},"resource-types":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Filter recommendations by one or more impacted Azure resource types using OR semantics. Each value matches properties.impactedField case-insensitively; pass a one-element array for one type."},"product-family":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by Azure product family before aggregation and ranking, with or without prioritization. Uses a case-insensitive exact match against the recommendation metadata service family. Any non-empty family name is accepted; no resource-provider fallback is used."},"resource":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by impacted resource name or full ARM resource ID. Uses a case-insensitive substring match."},"search":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendation problem text using a case-insensitive substring match. Prefer structured filters when an equivalent category, impact, subcategory, or resource-type filter exists."},"sub-category":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by metadata subcategory using a case-insensitive exact match. Known values include IdleResources, ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement, ZoneResiliency, and RegionalResiliency; future non-empty catalog values are accepted."},"retirement-date":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by service-retirement date in \u0027\u003Coperator\u003E:\u003Cyyyy-MM-dd\u003E\u0027 format, for example \u0027le:2026-12-31\u0027. Supported operators are eq, lt, le, gt, and ge. The ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement subcategory is inferred when omitted."},"minimum-savings":{"type":["number","null"],"description":"For Cost with subcategory IdleResources, include only recommendations whose structured annualized retail potential savings (daily savings \u00D7 12 \u00D7 30.4) are at least this non-negative USD amount. Missing pricing does not satisfy the threshold; zero is valid."},"as-of":{"type":["string","null"],"format":"date-time","description":"For Cost with subcategory IdleResources, calculate savings as of this UTC timestamp. Use an ISO 8601 timestamp such as 2026-09-30T23:59:59Z. Defaults status to Completed unless explicitly supplied. Historical values are Advisor estimates, not billing data."},"from":{"type":["string","null"],"format":"date-time","description":"For historical Cost/IdleResources summaries, filter completed recommendations by deletion on or after this UTC timestamp. Requires category Cost and subcategory IdleResources. Defaults status to Completed unless explicitly supplied."},"to":{"type":["string","null"],"format":"date-time","description":"For historical Cost/IdleResources summaries, filter completed recommendations by deletion on or before this UTC timestamp. Requires category Cost and subcategory IdleResources. Defaults status to Completed unless explicitly supplied."},"top":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Optional display cap from 1 through 100 on the number of known buckets returned. Defaults to 10 with --prioritized true, where buckets keep their priority order. TotalRecommendations and summary.cost still reflect the complete filtered population (with --prioritized true, TotalRecommendations is the sum of affected resources per type), and in non-prioritized summaries an Unknown bucket is preserved after the selected buckets."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."},"subscriptions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"One or more subscription IDs or names to query. Pass a one-element array for one subscription; aliases of the same subscription are queried once. Specify either --subscriptions or --service-group. When both are omitted, the configured default subscription is used."},"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."}},"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"advisor_recommendation_list","description":"List, show, or search individual Azure Advisor recommendations and their affected-resource details in a subscription or Azure Service Group. For --category Cost --sub-category IdleResources, show unused resources and their estimated savings across subscriptions or a Service Group. Supports metadata service-family and minimum annual potential-savings filters. Supports filters for category, subcategory, impact, recommendation status such as New, Postponed, Dismissed, or Completed, recommendation type ID, affected resource, resource type, free text, tracking ID, retirement date, and scope. This returns recommendation instances, not the global metadata catalog, recommendation types, or service-retirement metadata by Service Health tracking ID; use advisor metadata list for those catalog lookups. For status-filtered requests, use this tool to retrieve individual recommendations; use summary only for status counts or grouped analysis. If a request has broad or unscoped top, critical, important, prioritized, priority, or equivalent prioritization intent and does not identify a specific recommendation type, do not use this tool; route to recommendation summary with --group-by recommendation-type and --prioritized true. If the request identifies a specific recommendation type, use this tool directly with a one-element --recommendation-type-ids array and --prioritized true to order its individual recommendations. For non-prioritized requests to retrieve individual recommendations, use this tool directly with any supported filters; a prior summary call is not required. Use summary for counts, totals, rankings, distributions, or grouped analysis rather than aggregating this tool\u0027s limited results. After a summary, use this tool to retrieve individual recommendations or affected resources for a selected group by passing its key in a one-element --recommendation-type-ids array and preserving the applicable filters. Choose either subscription scope, optionally narrowed by resource group, or Service Group scope; the configured default subscription is used when neither is supplied. Returns recommendations in ARM resource shape and a truncation indicator. Each recommendation\u0027s name is its recommendation ID.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by category (e.g., \u0027Security\u0027, \u0027Cost\u0027, \u0027Performance\u0027, \u0027HighAvailability\u0027, \u0027OperationalExcellence\u0027). Case-insensitive exact match against English recommendation metadata."},"impact":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by business impact (\u0027High\u0027, \u0027Medium\u0027, or \u0027Low\u0027). Case-insensitive exact match against English recommendation metadata."},"status":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by status (\u0027New\u0027, \u0027Postponed\u0027, \u0027Dismissed\u0027, or \u0027Completed\u0027). Defaults to \u0027New\u0027 when omitted."},"recommendation-type-ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Filter recommendations by one or more recommendation type ID GUIDs using OR semantics. Matching is case-insensitive. Pass a one-element array for one type; prioritization requires exactly one distinct type."},"resource-types":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Filter recommendations by one or more impacted Azure resource types using OR semantics. Each value requires a case-insensitive exact match against the supported resource type in English recommendation metadata and a case-insensitive substring match in the instance resource ID."},"product-family":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by Azure product family using a case-insensitive exact match against the recommendation metadata service family. Any non-empty family name is accepted; no resource-provider fallback is used."},"resource":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by a case-insensitive substring of the impacted resource\u0027s full ARM resource ID. Accepts a resource name or resource ID."},"search":{"type":"string","description":"Free-text filter applied to the recommendation problem text (case-insensitive substring match). Prefer a structured filter when it expresses the request; use search for topics such as \u0027encryption\u0027 or \u0027right-size\u0027. Matches the original instance problem text before metadata enrichment."},"sub-category":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by recommendation subcategory, matched case-insensitively against the Advisor recommendation metadata. Known values include ComputeOptimization, DataPerformance, DataProtectionAndRecovery, EfficiencyOptimization, FailureMitigation, GovernanceAndCompliance, IdleResources, MonitoringAndAlerting, NetworkOptimization, Other, RegionalResiliency, Reservations, SafeAndSecureDeployment, SavingsPlan, Scalability, ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement, StorageOptimization, UsageOptimization, and ZoneResiliency. Advisor can add values over time, so other subcategories are accepted."},"tracking-ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Filter recommendations by one or more Service Health tracking IDs, such as QNY1-HB8. Pass several IDs as space-separated values after one option, for example --tracking-ids QNY1-HB8 9G0V-_G8; recommendations matching any of them are returned. Matched case-insensitively within ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement metadata. Can be combined with --retirement-date. --sub-category may be omitted; when specified, it must be ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement."},"retirement-date":{"type":"string","description":"Filter recommendations by the service-retirement date in English recommendation metadata, using \u0027\u003Coperator\u003E:\u003Cyyyy-MM-dd\u003E\u0027 format, for example \u0027ge:2026-03-31\u0027. Supported operators are eq, lt, le, gt, and ge. Can be combined with --tracking-ids. --sub-category may be omitted; when specified, it must be ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement."},"minimum-savings":{"type":["number","null"],"description":"For Cost with subcategory IdleResources, return only records whose structured annualized retail potential savings (daily savings \u00D7 12 \u00D7 30.4) are at least this non-negative USD amount. Missing pricing does not satisfy the threshold; zero is valid."},"top":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Maximum number of individual recommendation records to return, not distinct affected resources or recommendation groups. For broad or unscoped top, critical, important, prioritized, priority, or equivalent prioritization intent that does not identify a specific recommendation type, use summary --group-by recommendation-type --prioritized true first and pass the requested count to summary --top. For a request that identifies a specific recommendation type, this option limits the individual records returned after --prioritized true orders them. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to the server-side range of 1 through 100. This is a result limit, not aggregate prioritization."},"continuation-token":{"type":"string","description":"Continuation token returned by the preceding page. Pass it unchanged with the same scope, tenant, filters, ordering and page size. Omit for the first page."},"service-group":{"type":"string","description":"List recommendations for an Azure Service Group instead of a subscription, provided as the name segment of its ARM resource ID (the \u0027{serviceGroupName}\u0027 in \u0027/providers/Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups/{serviceGroupName}\u0027). A unique display name or full ARM resource ID is also accepted in the selected tenant; ambiguous display names produce an error listing matching full ARM IDs for explicit selection. Specify either --service-group or --subscriptions, not both. If both are omitted, the configured default subscription is used. --resource-group applies only to subscription scope. Other filters (category, impact, status, search, etc.) and --prioritized still apply."},"prioritized":{"type":["boolean","null"],"description":"Apply ordering to individual matching records, not recommendation groups. Broad or unscoped top, critical, important, prioritized, priority, or equivalent prioritization intent that does not identify a specific recommendation type must use summary --group-by recommendation-type --prioritized true first. A request that identifies a specific recommendation type can use this option directly; setting it to true requires exactly one distinct --recommendation-type-ids value. The selected type\u0027s recommendation metadata category determines the instance metric. For Cost types, sort by savings; for all other types, sort by criticalityScore descending, treating missing scores as zero. Retail savings are in USD; contractual pricing and billing currency do not affect this ranking. savings.retail.dailyPotentialSavings is converted to an annual value by multiplying by 12 and 30.4, with extendedProperties.annualSavingsAmount as fallback outside Cost/IdleResources. Cost with subcategory IdleResources uses structured yearly potential savings for New, Postponed, and Dismissed, or whole-day, zero-clamped realized savings for Completed, without legacy monetary fallback. The prioritized savings score is rounded to two decimals before ordering descending. Without --prioritized, Cost/IdleResources orders by unrounded lifecycle savings descending, then recommendation ID ascending. Missing, invalid, or non-finite savings sort last; zero is valid. Ties sort by effective retirement date ascending (instance date with metadata fallback, missing dates last), then resource name A-Z (case-insensitive), then recommendation ID A-Z. Defaults to false; when false, only Cost with subcategory IdleResources has explicit savings ordering. Applies to both subscription and Service Group scopes."},"show-prioritization-signals":{"type":["boolean","null"],"description":"Include the original properties.signalBreakdown payload from Azure Resource Graph when present, preserving its backend-provided JSON shape. Defaults to false. Setting this option to true requires --prioritized true; otherwise validation fails. Including signals does not change filtering or ordering. Applies to both subscription and Service Group scopes. The field is omitted when signals are unavailable."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."},"subscriptions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"One or more subscription IDs or names to query. Pass a one-element array for one subscription; aliases of the same subscription are queried once. Specify either --subscriptions or --service-group. When both are omitted, the configured default subscription is used."},"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."}},"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"advisor_recommendation_prevalidate","description":"Check whether affected resources for one selected Azure Advisor Cost/IdleResources recommendation type pass read-only pre-deletion validation. Use for explicit safety, dependency, lock, recent-activity, or ready-to-delete checks, not ordinary recommendation listing or savings analysis. Uses current New recommendations and the onboarded ResourceInsights definitions to recheck detection, minimum unused age (30 days by default), management locks, resource-specific risks, and visible dependencies. Choose one or more subscriptions or a single Service Group. Pass exact affected-resource IDs when validating selected rows. Returns per-resource safe, needsReview, or blocked verdicts, evidence, manual checks, Retail USD savings, unmatched selections, and a truncation indicator. Unknown or incomplete gating evidence requires review. Passing automated checks does not authorize deletion. Never deletes resources, executes scripts, or changes recommendation state.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"recommendation-type-id":{"type":"string","description":"The exact Advisor recommendation type ID GUID selected from existing recommendations. Only onboarded Cost/IdleResources deletion recommendations support prevalidation."},"resources":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Selected affected resources, as exact full ARM resource IDs only. Reuse IDs already returned by recommendation list; resolve user-supplied names through list when IDs are unavailable and disambiguate before calling. Omit to validate the selected recommendation type across the scope. Missing selections are reported, not treated as safe."},"top":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Optional positive maximum number of affected resources to validate after exact selection. Omit to validate all matching resources. Processing uses bounded batches without imposing a 25-resource total limit. Incomplete discovery or an explicit limit is reported as truncated coverage."},"minimum-unused-days":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Minimum unused age in days, from 1 through 365. Defaults to 30. Pass a one-element array for one subscription. Cannot be combined with --service-group. When both scopes are omitted, the configured default subscription is used."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."},"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."}},"required":["recommendation-type-id"],"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"advisor_metadata_list","description":"List the global Azure Advisor recommendation metadata catalog, also known as recommendation types. Use this for metadata catalog lookups, including service-retirement metadata by Service Health tracking ID (for example, QNY1-HB8), or to discover what recommendations Advisor could produce before deploying resources, even when there are no active recommendations. Show Advisor service retirements on, before, or after a specified retirement date. For current recommendation records or affected resources, use advisor recommendation list instead. The global Azure Resource Graph catalog supports greenfield discovery and resource-type filtering for brownfield onboarding. Optional filters include language, resource type, impact, category, subcategory, tracking ID, and retirement date. Returns localized type IDs, names, categories, subcategories, impact, priority, descriptions, benefits, actions, scope, source query, and service-retirement details, ordered by impact from High to Medium to Low and then by display name.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"continuation-token":{"type":"string","description":"Continuation token returned by the preceding page. Pass it unchanged with the same scope, tenant, filters, ordering and page size. Omit for the first page."},"language":{"type":"string","description":"Language for localized recommendation metadata. Defaults to English (\u0027en\u0027). Supported catalog languages are en, cs, de, es, fr, hu, id, it, ja, ko, nl, pl, pt-BR, pt-PT, ru, sv, tr, zh-Hans, and zh-Hant. Regional variants map to a supported base language when available, such as en-US to en and fr-CA to fr; locale-specific catalog languages remain distinct."},"resource-type":{"type":"string","description":"Optional exact Azure resource type filter, such as \u0027microsoft.compute/virtualmachines\u0027. Use it during brownfield onboarding to discover recommendation types applicable to that resource type. Matched case-insensitively."},"impact":{"type":"string","description":"Optional recommendation impact filter. Allowed values are High, Medium, or Low. Matched case-insensitively; unfiltered results are ordered High, Medium, then Low."},"category":{"type":"string","description":"Optional exact Advisor category filter. Allowed values are Cost, HighAvailability, Security, Performance, and OperationalExcellence. Matched case-insensitively."},"sub-category":{"type":"string","description":"Optional exact recommendation subcategory filter, matched case-insensitively. Known catalog values include ComputeOptimization, DataPerformance, DataProtectionAndRecovery, EfficiencyOptimization, FailureMitigation, GovernanceAndCompliance, MonitoringAndAlerting, NetworkOptimization, Other, Personalized, RegionalResiliency, Reservations, SafeAndSecureDeployment, SavingsPlan, Scalability, ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement, StorageOptimization, UsageOptimization, and ZoneResiliency. The catalog can add values over time, so other subcategories are accepted."},"tracking-id":{"type":"string","description":"Optional exact Service Health tracking ID filter, such as QNY1-HB8. Matched case-insensitively within ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement metadata. --sub-category may be omitted but cannot specify a different value."},"retirement-date":{"type":"string","description":"Optional service-retirement date filter in \u0027\u003Coperator\u003E:\u003Cyyyy-MM-dd\u003E\u0027 format, for example \u0027ge:2026-03-31\u0027. Supported operators are eq, lt, le, gt, and ge. Applies only to the ServiceUpgradeAndRetirement subcategory; --sub-category may be omitted but cannot specify a different value."}},"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"advisor_metadata_get","description":"Get Azure Advisor metadata for a specific recommendation type id. This is the join key shared with individual recommendations. Required."},"language":{"type":"string","description":"Catalog locale to filter on (properties.language). Defaults to \u0027en\u0027. Use this whenever you are asked how to fix or how to resolve an Advisor recommendation. Returns its remediation package: step-by-step remediation steps plus ready-to-run artifacts, scripts, and deployment templates in ARM template, Bicep, Azure CLI, PowerShell, and terraform formats to remediate the issue. Also indicates remediation characteristics such as whether it is destructive, reversible, or grounded, along with its confidence, effort, and output type. Use whenever you need to fix, resolve, remediate, or verify a recommendation, or want the ARM, Bicep, CLI, PowerShell, or terraform artifacts and scripts to remediate it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"recommendation-type-id":{"type":"string","description":"The Advisor recommendation type id (GUID) whose remediation package should be fetched. Must be a 36-character GUID in the form xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx. Required."}},"required":["recommendation-type-id"],"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"advisor_insight_list","description":"Show Azure Advisor pre-aggregated insights for one Service Group, one subscription, or across all accessible Service Groups and subscriptions. Use for pre-aggregated insight KPIs: idle resource counts and potential savings, zonal resiliency coverage percentages, and service retirement baseline and current exposure counts. For Service Groups, answer how many idle resources exist and their potential savings amount in USD. Get ServiceRetirement insights for subscriptions and Service Groups, including Day 1 baseline exposure, current remaining exposure, and burndown percentage. Compare baseline and current counts to measure retirement exposure reduction or increase, and compare scopes by remaining retirement backlog. Identify subscriptions or Service Groups that have reached 100 percent burndown with zero remaining retirement exposure. Show how much a subscription\u0027s service retirement exposure has reduced or increased since its Day 1 baseline count. Get ServiceRetirement baseline and current exposure for a subscription; compare subscriptions or Service Groups by remaining retirement exposure. Optionally filter by --insight-name (IdleResources, ZonalResiliency, ServiceRetirement) and cap results with --top (default 50, max 500). Each insight returns name, domain, scope type and ID, last updated time, and KPIs with typed values (USD amounts include a unit). Returns pre-aggregated insight KPIs, not individual resource or recommendation lists. For recommendation insights, use advisor recommendation summary; for individual recommendations and affected resources, use advisor recommendation list.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"service-group":{"type":"string","description":"Service Group name (for example \u0027commerce\u0027), not its full ARM ID. Returns insights for that Service Group. Mutually exclusive with --subscription. Omit both --service-group and --subscription to return insights across all accessible Service Groups and subscriptions."},"insight-name":{"type":"string","description":"Filter by insight name: IdleResources, ZonalResiliency, or ServiceRetirement. Case-insensitive exact match. Omit to return all insights for the scope."},"top":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Maximum number of insights to return (1-500, default 50)."},"subscription":{"type":"string","description":"Azure subscription ID or name. Returns insights for that subscription (only service retirement applies). Mutually exclusive with --service-group. No default subscription is applied."},"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."}},"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"advisor_servicegroupintelligence_get","description":"Get the current Azure Advisor status and criticality of Service Groups, showing which Service Groups are at risk, need attention, are critical or on track. Use for questions about the status of one Service Group or all Service Groups, and which mission critical (Tier 0) or other tier Service Groups need attention.
